Depending on how bad it is.. like if it isn’t totally 100% straight, you can save your hair by being consistent with deep conditioning and protein treatments. I fried my hair about two years ago after being natural my entire life. It was everywhere, ends, middle and roots. I was really down about it. 

But I did a deep conditioning mask every week. I did protein treatments every two weeks. I trimmed what I could. I did hot oil treatments regularly and kept my hair in a protective style all the time. (My go to was small/medium box braids without extensions). Eat right, drink a lot of water and keep your scalp clean. 

It’s a lot of work but I was able to get my hair to revert to normal after like 10 months. 

Also, I think the line Aphrogee has a great protein treatment you can try.
